mapper.select: select distinct t2.id as productPlanId, t2.process_id, t2.process_name, t2.process_version, t2.batch_no, t2.start_time, t2.archive_status, t2.is_relation as related from bm_product_plan_relation t1 left join bm_product_plan t2 on t1.relation_product_plan_id = t2.id where t1.product_plan_id = #{productPlanId} and t1.is_direct_relation = 'TRUE'
